official_source: libzhl/HookSystem.cpp:397-424 stores hooks in multimap<int,...,greater<int>> and installs in descending priority order.

libzhl/HookSystem.cpp:558 onward installs detours; generated _internalSuper calls the prior original/trampoline; because higher values install first, lower values installed later wrap outside and enter first.
repentogon/dllmain.cpp:69-76 documents lower numeric priority runs first, higher runs last before original.
loader/loader.cpp:130-190 loads/initializes DLLs, then calls ZHL::Init at line 190.
short_circuit_callbacks: repentogon/Patches/ASMPatches/ASMCallbacks.cpp:30-34 has Game::Update priority-0 Hook that clears s_callbackPause before super().
repentogon/Patches/ASMPatches/ASMGridEntityCollision.cpp:28-31 has priority-0 Game::Update Hook whose work follows super().
repentogon/Patches/ASMPatches/ASMCallbacks.cpp:41-113 implements MC_PRE_UPDATE; true skips the target body between marker and return.
repentogon/LuaInterfaces/CustomCallbacks.cpp:499-541 callback 1160 can avoid the normal Player super chain and call Entity::Original_Update instead.
hook_priority_and_current_source.unknown: Game::Update 同优先级 C/S 与两个官方 0 Hook 的相对注册顺序本次静态未定；实际进程 DLL 列表、callback 状态、Hook 是否成功安装及可能更内层的未知 Hook 未动态验证。Manager -10000 wrapper 收束处在这些下游 Hook 返回之后。
